scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ad-voice/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @ad-voice/playground
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ad-voice/ui && npm run build --workspace @ad-voice/playground
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build --workspace @ad-voice/ui && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true})" && npm pack ./packages/ui --pack-destination release
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --workspace @ad-voice/ui --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --workspace @ad-voice/ui --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm version major --workspace @ad-voice/ui --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
